name: Gekka no Kirameki
source:
There is a small independent country " Seikoku" located in remote mountains. Main character gets attacked by a zombie one night. Then a large army of the dead comes under the walls. Among protagonist's troops one girl is found out to manipulate zombies. A way to oppose this huge undead threat must be found with any means possible.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
偏远山区有一个名为圣国的小型独立国家。

一天夜里，主角遭到僵尸袭击。随后，大批亡者军队来到城墙下。

主角的部队中发现了一名能够操纵僵尸的女孩。无论使用什么手段，都必须找到对抗这场巨大亡灵威胁的方法。

[来自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
